description: Be proactive and ahead of the game by collecting necessary information to make better choices. #selflove #proactive #discernment
transcript: Collect data, collect information in order to make conscious decisions. There is nothing new under the sun. People will reveal exactly who they are to you. Environments will reveal what their expectations are of you. When you sit back in stillness and allow information to be presented to you, become better informed, you are able to take more control of your life. For not many things that are surprises, the truth always reveals itself. Discernment and proactivity is key.
